divergences.reason: Classic lifecycle model calibrated on pre-AI projects; includes analysis through test, uses a small-project exponent that produces high fixed overhead, and assumes 1980s productivity. Treated as an upper bound, not a correction.
E=1.10 from low process maturity and high team/precedent ratings; high RELY/CPLX and low TOOL push effort up. Still a full-lifecycle model, not a task-level rebuild.

Counts service/API data movements only and excludes UI, docs, ops and hardening; low confidence and subjective functional-process count.
Within the 35% threshold; benchmark midpoint. Same SLOC input as the COCOMO/FP cluster.

reconciliation.decision: Bottom-up remains primary. COCOMO 81/II bound the upper end; IFPUG and the SLOC benchmark are sanity checks; COSMIC is a low-confidence independent check. No silent averaging.
reconciliation.scope_alignment: COCOMO and IFPUG cover analysis through test; the bottom-up includes docs, deployment, hardening and coordination. Removing those (about 120 h) gives a COCOMO-aligned bottom-up of roughly 700 h; COCOMO remains 2.6-3.1x higher.

final_verdict.what: A self-hosted, zero-dependency OpenAI-compatible AI gateway: routing, key pools, failover, cooldowns, probes, response cache, budgets, capability routing, telemetry, Prometheus metrics, backups, config transfer and a vanilla JS admin dashboard.
final_verdict.difficulty: 6.1/10 Moderate. The hard parts are the streaming proxy and failover state machine, then the security/ops surface; the CRUD and UI are routine.
final_verdict.planning: 78/100 Sound, Medium confidence. The architecture is coherent and the code follows it; the main weaknesses are no ADRs, a stale contributing guide and 7-12% planning-gap rework.
final_verdict.effort: Historical: 42 h total (30-58 h, Low confidence), of which 29 h (20-40 h) is the current Node scope; 13 h was the abandoned PHP v1. Human-only rebuild today: 820 h (644-1,032 h), 27.3 calendar weeks.
final_verdict.scenarios: Human + 50% AI: 559 h (32% saving). Human + 75% AI: 492 h (40% saving). Human planner / AI executor: 262 human hours (68% saving), plus about 190 h of agent wall-clock. AI automation potential: 67/100.
final_verdict.industry: Models span 600-2,153 h. IFPUG backfire (+5.9%) and the SLOC benchmark (+32.3%) are near the bottom-up; COSMIC is 26.8% lower; COCOMO 81/II are 2.2-2.6x higher. Bottom-up remains primary.
final_verdict.humans: Architecture, security review, streaming/failover debugging, quota/budget concurrency, UX decisions, production deployment and integration QA still need a human.
final_verdict.risks: Historical undercount from bulk commits, classic-model overcount, no external plan, untested frontend and excluded legacy are the largest risks.
final_verdict.confidence: Medium overall: size High, code quality Medium-High, historical Low, bottom-up Medium, scenarios Medium-Low, architect Medium.
